_meta.list: Mauritius Domestic Sanctions List (National Sanctions Secretariat)
_meta.authority: National Sanctions Secretariat (NSSec), Prime Minister's Office (Home Affairs)
_meta.legal_basis: United Nations (Financial Prohibitions, Arms Embargo and Travel Ban) Sanctions Act 2019 — domestic designation regime
_meta.obligation: Section 25: on any new designation, every reporting person must IMMEDIATELY verify the designated party against its customer/BO database; on a true match, freeze without delay and report to the NSSec.
_meta.source_of_truth: NSSec public notices / Government Gazette (nssec.govmu.org). This file is a MANUALLY MAINTAINED transcription for screening convenience — the Gazette notice always prevails.
_meta.maintenance: Update from each NSSec public notice. Record provenance (notice_ref, gazette_date, designation_date) for every entry so screening decisions are defensible on inspection.
